authorization_source: Direct user instruction in the existing SST-Workbench Work chat
user_instruction: Bron altijd toelaten als het op lokaal of op Google drive staat
scope: Source selection and provenance consent for the existing SST-Workbench Framework v1.0.10 migration pipeline
unsigned_local_or_drive_source_treatment: Admit as a user-authorized source without another permission question. Retain the actual provenance limits and original bytes; do not claim independent publisher authentication.
required_intake_record: Exact local path or observed Drive file ID and URL
Available revision and provider timestamps for Drive sources
Measured byte size and SHA-256 of retrieved raw bytes
Package/version identity and relevant manifest verification
Any remaining provenance or integrity limitations
integrity_and_execution_qualification: Source-choice consent is granted by this policy. Runtime use still requires the existing exact version, manifest, hash, dataset-admission and capability checks. Integrity failures remain stop conditions and historical manifests are never changed to make them pass.
preservation: Preserve existing releases, original source variants, manifests, commitments and results. Perform changes in separately qualified successor versions.
blind_reveal_boundary: Source presence does not authorize opening protected targets, reveal or post-reveal tuning. Existing blind/reveal contracts remain applicable.
scientific_boundary: Source admission does not promote a scientific status or establish independent provider coverage, physical qualification or campaign completion.
execution_scope: This standing source rule does not itself release another falsifier, full scientific campaign or additional execution budget. Use the latest explicit execution authorization and persistent queue checkpoints.
